top_signals.title: Stocks Fall as Treasury 10-Year Yield Rises to 5%: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Wall Street traders sent stocks and bonds lower in the countdown to the Federal Reserve decision as elevated oil prices raised concerns about inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: US Stocks Fall as 10-Year Yield Hits Highest Level Since 2007
top_signals.summary: US stocks fell at the open after the benchmark Treasury yield touched the highest level since 2007 ahead of a Federal Reserve interest-rate decision on Wednesday, when traders expect an increase.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: The New Airport Luxury Is A $5K Private Lounge For Flying Commercial
top_signals.summary: Massages, private suites, a chauffeur to drive you straight to your plane. At airports around the US, new luxury terminals offer the perks of flying private, without actually flying on a private jet. Bloomberg's Aashna Shah got a first-hand look. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Trump calls Supreme Court mail ballot ruling 'big loss for Republicans'
top_signals.summary: President Trump blasted his three Supreme Court appointees for blocking a Postal Service rule that would have allowed mail-in ballots in November's elections.
